rules.name: Title required
rules.description: Every work item must have a non-empty title.

rules.name: Description required
rules.description: Every work item must have a description.

rules.name: Type required
rules.description: Work item type is mandatory.

rules.name: Assignee required
rules.description: Assigned To is mandatory and must resolve to a real team member.

rules.name: Assignee invalid
rules.description: Do not invent names. Assignee must exist in the configured team.

rules.name: Area required
rules.description: Area Path is mandatory.

rules.name: Area invalid
rules.description: Area Path must exist in Azure DevOps. Invented paths fail.

rules.name: Iteration required
rules.description: Iteration is mandatory and must exist.

rules.name: Iteration invalid
rules.description: Do not invent sprint names.

rules.name: State required
rules.description: State is mandatory.

rules.name: State invalid
rules.description: State must exist on the process. Never invent QA, Done, Ready for Release, etc.

rules.name: Priority required
rules.description: Priority is mandatory.

rules.name: Planned Start required
rules.description: Planned Start is mandatory for planned work.

rules.name: Planned End required
rules.description: Planned End is mandatory for planned work.

rules.name: Planned date order
rules.description: Planned Start must be on or before Planned End.

rules.name: Invalid date format
rules.description: Dates must be valid ISO date/datetime values.

rules.name: No fake actual dates
rules.description: Newly planned items must not have Actual Start or Actual End. Planned is intent; Actual is fact.

rules.name: No future actual dates
rules.description: Do not create future Actual dates.

rules.name: Parent required
rules.description: Feature, User Story and Task must have a valid parent. Epic has no parent.

rules.name: Epic is root
rules.description: Epic must not have a parent.

rules.name: Valid hierarchy
rules.description: Epic→Feature→User Story→Task. No Task under Epic/Feature, no Story under Epic, no Feature under Story.

rules.name: Child dates within parent
rules.description: Child planned period must fit inside the parent planned period.

rules.name: Epic iteration is end sprint
rules.description: Epic iteration is the expected END sprint, not the start sprint.

rules.name: Feature not on past sprint
rules.description: Feature iteration must not be a past sprint.

rules.name: Task iteration matches story
rules.description: Task iteration must match its parent User Story.

rules.name: Dates feasible for iteration
rules.description: Planned dates should be feasible for the selected iteration window.

rules.name: Story acceptance criteria
rules.description: A User Story must have acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready).

rules.name: Story has a task
rules.description: A complete plan requires at least one meaningful Task under each User Story.

rules.name: Feature has a story
rules.description: A complete plan requires one or more User Stories under each Feature.

rules.name: Meaningful title
rules.description: Do not use generic phase/status titles (Development, Testing, Authentication, Moved to PRD, …).

rules.name: No status-only items
rules.description: Do not create fake release/status stories such as Ready for Release or QA/Validation.

rules.name: No ceremony placeholders
rules.description: Do not create tasks only for meetings, ceremonies, or administrative placeholders.

rules.name: Over-decomposition
rules.description: Do not explode the hierarchy; smallest complete tree.

rules.name: Parent/child state consistency
rules.description: Do not leave a parent Active when all children are New or all Closed.

rules.name: Story Definition of Ready
rules.description: Story cannot be Active without title, description, AC, parent Feature, dates, and iteration.

rules.name: Task Definition of Ready
rules.description: Task cannot be Active without parent Story, meaningful title, and planned end.

rules.name: Bug reproduction steps
rules.description: Bugs require description and reproduction steps.

rules.name: Obvious duplicate
rules.description: Exact or near-exact title already exists in Azure DevOps or in this plan.

rules.name: Possible duplicate
rules.description: Similar existing work needs user review.

rules.name: Dependency target missing
rules.description: Dependency must reference an existing or proposed work item.

rules.name: Circular dependency
rules.description: Dependencies must not form a cycle.

rules.name: Dependency date order
rules.description: Successor planned start must be on or after predecessor planned end when both dates exist.

rules.name: Dependency unclear
rules.description: Insufficient dependency data; do not invent assumptions.

rules.name: Capacity overload
rules.description: Assigned work may exceed available sprint capacity. User may accept overload.

rules.name: Capacity unverified
rules.description: Capacity could not be verified because capacity data is unavailable.
